questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句：if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

questions.prompt: ___ she studies hard, she will pass the exam.
questions.explanation: 表示“如果”用 If，引导条件从句。
questions.evidence: If she studies hard, she will pass the exam.

questions.prompt: The road is wet. ___, we should drive slowly.
questions.explanation: 前句是原因，后句是结果，用 Therefore 表示“因此”。
questions.evidence: The road is wet. Therefore, we should drive slowly.

questions.prompt: He is tired ___ he worked all day.
questions.explanation: because 引导原因从句，表示“因为”。
questions.evidence: He is tired because he worked all day.

questions.prompt: You ___ drink more water. It is good for you.
If you finish your homework, you ___ watch TV.
questions.explanation: 这里表示“可以”看电视，用 can 表示允许。
questions.evidence: If you finish your homework, you can watch TV.

questions.prompt: We ___ recycle paper and plastic. It is important.
questions.explanation: must 表示“必须”，语气最强。
questions.evidence: We must recycle paper and plastic.

questions.prompt: If I see him, I ___ him the news.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句主句用 will + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: If I see him, I will tell him the news.

title: The Repair Café on Willow Street · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
第一条件句表示“如果……就……”，结构是：If + 一般现在时，主语 + will + 动词原形。例如：If we repair things, we will produce less waste. because 表示原因，therefore 表示结果。情态动词 should / could / must 用来提建议或说必须做的事：should 表示“应该”，could 表示“可以（建议）”，must 表示“必须”。

"If you show me how to fix it, I will try at home."
